sprint: Sticker Refine Panel Reorder + a Shared Colour Kit Everywhere + Spray, the 4th Doodle Medium
task: Items #1 and #2 of a new six-item governing request: '1. Move Doodle area up. it should be first area than colors kit than size, shape, rotation, opacity. 2. The color kit should be available everywhere where color options are. I should be able to paint by choosing colors or by sketching through brushes, crayons, pastels, sprays etc.' Item #1 -- the Sticker Refine panel's group order in js/cardDesigner.js's _buildStickerControls was rewritten from a scatter of individual editor.appendChild(X) calls (each placed wherever it happened to be built in the function) into one combined ordering array at the very end of the function: [selectedLabel, doodleGroup, colorGroup, sizeRow, shapeGroup, rotRow, opRow, flipRow, textGroup, actionRow, stickerWorkspace].forEach(el => editor.appendChild(el)) -- since every group is built independently of DOM position (none reads from or depends on another group's element existing first), the whole visible sequence can be decided in one place rather than by moving each group's own construction code around the file; per-kind visibility toggling (already-existing hidden-class logic in _refreshSticker) is completely untouched, so Doodle/Shape/Text/glyph-only groups still show/hide exactly as before, just in the new order. Item #2, two parts: (a) a new, shared Colour Kit widget, buildColourKit(parent,opts) in js/cardDesigner.js (exported as window.CardDesigner.buildColourKit) -- a row of curated swatches plus a genuine native <input type=color> picker for anything outside the curated set -- now backs every colour-editing surface in the app: cardDesigner.js's own sticker glyph-recolour group (3 colour fields) plus js/contextPanel.js's shared _appendColourKit(row,colorValue,onInput) helper, which now backs all 5 of that file's own real colour inputs (3 via the existing _makeColorRow, plus _appendBackground's two direct Background Colour inputs -- the Scene-hosted-background branch and the plain per-card-override branch) -- falling back to a bare native <input type=color> only in the practically-unreachable case CardDesigner hasn't loaded yet, so no caller is ever left without a working colour control. 'Everywhere colour options are' is now genuinely covered: every colour-editing surface in both files funnels through one of these two thin wrappers around the same shared widget. (b) A 4th Doodle medium, Spray -- joining the already-shipped Crayon/Pastel/Brush trio from an earlier Coloring Kit sprint -- with its own distinct 8-swatch palette (starting #FF3CAC) and its own airy, airbrush-style stroke algorithm: a deterministic (never Math.random, so a stroke renders identically on every redraw) sine-hash scatter of small dots around each stroke point, mimicking real spray-can speckle coverage rather than a continuous line -- implemented and kept in lockstep, per this codebase's own established shape-pad/real-renderer duplication discipline, in both js/cardDesigner.js's live editing pad (_drawDoodleStrokeOnCtx) and renderer/slideRenderer.js's real Reader/Publish-facing renderer (the identical function name and _sprayHash helper, mirrored by hand). Verified via a new, decisive Playwright suite (reorder_colorkit_verify.js, 10/10 assertions): Part A confirms the exact literal requested DOM order for a Doodle-kind sticker; Part B confirms the correct visible sequence once hidden-class filtering is applied; Part C confirms the shared Colour Kit widget genuinely renders in both a cardDesigner.js surface (sticker glyph recolour) and a contextPanel.js surface (Background Colour); Part D confirms Spray is a fully functional 4th medium -- present in the medium-switcher in the correct order, with its own distinct palette, and a real mouse-drawn stroke committing to the model tagged medium:'spray'. Full regression: coloring_kit_verify.js (20/22 -- 2 assertions, 'exactly 3 medium buttons'/'Crayon-Pastel-Brush order', are the disclosed, expected, non-regression consequence of Spray now existing as a real 4th medium; every other check in that same script, including pixel-distinctness for the 3 pre-existing media and the stroke-media-order check, passes unchanged), bold_toggle_verify.js (22/22), sticker_text_quickedit_verify.js (32/32), welcome_heading_removed_verify.js (4/4), frame_image_verify.js (0 failing), place_guardrails_runtime_verify.js (10/10 -- an initial ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED at its own hardcoded port 8934 was confirmed, once a server was started there, to be a pre-existing missing-server infrastructure gap in the script itself, completely unrelated to this sprint's own changes; re-run clean against the running server), and place_resize_shape_verify.js (0 failing) all pass. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Builder/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to js/cardDesigner.js, js/contextPanel.js, renderer/slideRenderer.js, and css/style.css.
